newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific in HK$12.5 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific in HK$12.5 bln loan.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd has secured a HK$12.5 billion syndicated loan facility to help finance its acquisition of 20 percent of China Light & Power Co Ltd, the South China Morning Post newspaper said on Tuesday.
It is the largest borrowing arrangement by a Beijing-backed conglomerate, the daily said.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia, Hang Seng Bank, Chase Manhattan Asia, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia and Banque Nationale de Paris will contribute HK$2.5 billion each to the facility, the newspaper said.
The facility is to be used largely to finance CITIC Pacific's acquisition of a second tranche of 299 million new China Light shares, costing about HK$9.76 billion, the paper said.
Placement of the first tranche of 199 million shares, costing HK$6.50 billion, had been completed, CITIC said in a statement on Monday.
Officials from Citic Pacific were not immediately available to comment.
